topic: Compensation on damaged items (coupon and exchange credit)

topic: Not Satisfied, extra options (10% refund, 30% coupon)

topic: Late compensation, when it starts and what is offered

topic: DNR, whether a refund can be offered

topic: Over 100 days, which date counts and what is offered

topic: Adding an engraving or charm after purchase, discounts and the three special products
proposed_fact: Without Future Engraving, a charm or engraving is added by a discounted reorder: MYKA and theo grace non-premium 70% off, premium 50% off, Oak & Luna 50% and 30%. Coupons of 30% (MYKA) or 20% (Oak & Luna) apply when the item is archived or the maximum is reached.
